question.prompt: Peter’s family ordered a \(12\)-slice pizza for dinner. Peter ate one slice and shared another slice equally with his brother Paul. What fraction of the pizza did Peter eat?

solutions.explanation:
One slice is \(1/12\) of the pizza. Peter also ate half of another slice, which is
\[
\frac1{12}\div2=\frac1{24}
\]
of the pizza. His total share was
\[
\frac1{12}+\frac1{24}
=\frac2{24}+\frac1{24}
=\frac3{24}=\boxed{\frac18},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
solutions.title: Combine the two portions
